dataCta.title: Data-Driven Intelligence.
dataCta.description: Stop guessing. We've built an interconnected 3D platform targeting the Pearl River Delta to map, vet, and shortlist the most capable suppliers.

hero.title: Bringing Products to Life
hero.description: At ATLAX, we bridge strategic sourcing, deep engineering expertise, and quality surveillance into one seamless process. With on-the-ground capability across Asia, we help hardware brands scale confidently.

blocks.title: Strategic Sourcing
blocks.description: We find, qualify, and manage the right factory partners, ensuring your production stays agile, transparent, and highly competitive globally.

listItems.text: Access our deeply vetted network of tier-1 and tier-2 vendors spanning electronics, plastics, to soft-goods.
Expand beyond a single region to mitigate tariff risk.
Rigorous facility auditing for IP protection, compliance, and scalability.
Multi-vendor comparisons to guarantee you are receiving authentic market-rate COGS.

blocks.resultText: A resilient, aggressively optimized supply chain that protects your margins no matter the macroeconomic environment.

blocks.title: Product Engineering & DFM
blocks.description: We bridge the gap between design intent and production reality. Our leadership works directly beside your industrial design team to validate builds and optimize for scale.

listItems.text: Translating aesthetic CAD into moldable, assemble-able geometry to minimize tooling costs.
Strict gateway management spanning EVT, DVT, to PVT.
Rapid prototyping iteration to find the perfect equilibrium between quality, feel, and unit cost.
Turnkey handling for CE, FCC, RoHS, and other regulatory testing.

blocks.resultText: De-risked tooling capital and defect-free first production runs that are delivered fully certified and on schedule.

blocks.title: Quality Deploy
blocks.description: Our Quality Assurance programs stretch far beyond end-of-line inspection; they are engineered natively into the manufacturing pipeline to systematically prevent defects before tooling is even cut.

listItems.text: Defining precise, measurable acceptance standards (AQLs) customized for each product.
On-site surveillance including Incoming Quality (IQC), In-Process (IPQC), and Outgoing (OQC).
Immediate Corrective Action tracing (CAPA) working alongside factory floors to permanently eliminate defect vectors.
Translating fault data from Pilot Runs into mandatory design tweaks for Mass Production.

blocks.resultText: A militant, data-driven quality ecosystem that protects your brand's reputation by ensuring uniform excellence in every shipment.
